decisions.reason: Assyria conquered the northern kingdom of Israel and took its people into exile in 722 BC (2 Kings 17:6). Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon destroyed Jerusalem and took Judah into exile in 587 BC (2 Kings 25). Israel here means the whole people.

decisions.choice: gnawed his bones: finished off what was left
decisions.reason: The verb is made from the word for "bone" and is found only here: to break or crunch the bones. After the first lion ate the flesh, the second left nothing.

decisions.choice: Nebuchadrezzar: the form of the name used here
decisions.reason: Jeremiah usually spells the name Nebuchadrezzar, closer to its Babylonian form, Nabu-kudurri-usur (21:2; 25:9); in some chapters it is Nebuchadnezzar (27:6). Both name the same king.

decisions.choice: a scattered sheep driven off by lions
decisions.reason: The flock of verse 6 is pictured again: a single sheep cut off from the flock, at the mercy of beasts of prey. The kings who attacked it are the lions.

decisions.choice: he has had his bones gnawed by Nebuchadrezzar (B); the people of Israel ... them (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the order of "first" and "last". Readable speaks of the people of Israel as "them", since the one sheep stands for the whole people, and says "like" to show the picture.

decisions.choice: la (feminine, for oveja)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of Israel as "him"; Spanish follows the image of the sheep (*oveja*) and uses the feminine.

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִ֥י פֹקֵ֛ד אֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְאֶל־אַרְצ֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקַ֖דְתִּי אֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says Yahweh of hosts, [the] God of Israel: look, I [am] punishing [the] king of Babylon and his land, as I punished [the] king of Assyria.

en.L: Therefore thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel: \q Look, I am going to punish the king of Babylon and his land, \q just as I punished the king of Assyria.
en.B: Therefore {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says this: \q I will bring punishment on the king of Babylon and on his land, \q as I did to the king of Assyria.
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says: \q I am going to punish the king of Babylon and his country, \q just as I punished the king of Assyria.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: \q He aquí, yo castigo al rey de Babilonia y a su tierra, \q como castigué al rey de Asiria.
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, dice esto: \q Castigaré al rey de Babilonia y a su tierra, \q como hice con el rey de Asiria.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: \q Voy a castigar al rey de Babilonia y a su país, \q así como castigué al rey de Asiria.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : \q Voici, je vais punir le roi de Babylone et son pays, \q comme j’ai puni le roi d’Assyrie.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : \q Je vais punir le roi de Babylone et son pays, \q comme je l’ai fait pour le roi d’Assyrie.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : \q Je vais punir le roi de Babylone et son pays, \q comme j’ai puni le roi d’Assyrie.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi, Mungu wa Israeli: \q Tazama, nitamwadhibu mfalme wa Babeli na nchi yake, \q kama nilivyomwadhibu mfalme wa Ashuru.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: \q Nitaleta adhabu juu ya mfalme wa Babeli na juu ya nchi yake, \q kama nilivyomtendea mfalme wa Ashuru.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: \q Nitamwadhibu mfalme wa Babeli na nchi yake, \q kama nilivyomwadhibu mfalme wa Ashuru.

vi.L: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: \q Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phạt vua Ba-by-lôn và xứ của nó, \q như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phạt vua A-si-ri.
vi.B: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy: \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt vua Ba-by-lôn và xứ của nó, \q như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã trừng phạt vua A-si-ri.
vi.R: Vì vậy, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt vua Ba-by-lôn và đất nước của nó, \q như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã trừng phạt vua A-si-ri.

decisions.choice: punish: visit with judgment
decisions.reason: The verb means to visit, to call to account, and so to punish (25:12; 46:25). The "look" with the verb in this form means God is about to act.

decisions.choice: as I punished the king of Assyria: Assyria's fall
decisions.reason: Assyria's capital, Nineveh, fell in 612 BC to the Babylonians and the Medes (Nahum 2-3), and the empire ended a few years later. The power that destroyed Assyria will now be judged in the same way.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD of hosts (L); the LORD of Armies ... says this (B); This is what the LORD of Armies says (R)
decisions.reason: The book's settled wording for the messenger formula and for the LORD of hosts, as in Isaiah.

source.text: וְשֹׁבַבְתִּ֤י אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־נָוֵ֔הוּ וְרָעָ֥ה הַכַּרְמֶ֖ל וְהַבָּשָׁ֑ן וּבְהַ֥ר אֶפְרַ֛יִם וְהַגִּלְעָ֖ד תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will bring back Israel to his pasture, and he will graze [on] Carmel and Bashan, and on [the] hill country of Ephraim and Gilead will be satisfied his appetite.

en.L: And I will bring Israel back to his pasture, \q and he will graze on Carmel and on Bashan, \q and on the hill country of Ephraim and in Gilead his appetite will be satisfied.
en.B: I will bring Israel back to his own pasture, \q and he will graze on Carmel and in Bashan; \q in the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead he will eat his fill.
en.R: But I will bring the people of Israel back to their own land, like sheep to their pasture. \q They will eat on Mount Carmel and in Bashan. \q They will eat all they want in the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.

es.L: Y haré volver a Israel a su pastizal, \q y pacerá en el Carmelo y en Basán, \q y en los montes de Efraín y en Galaad se saciará su alma.
es.B: Haré volver a Israel a su propio pastizal, \q y pacerá en el Carmelo y en Basán; \q en los montes de Efraín y en Galaad comerá hasta saciarse.
es.R: Pero haré que el pueblo de Israel vuelva a su tierra, como ovejas a su pastizal. \q Comerán en el monte Carmelo y en Basán. \q Comerán todo lo que quieran en los montes de Efraín y en Galaad.

fr.L: Et je ramènerai Israël à son pâturage, \q et il paîtra sur le Carmel et dans le Bashân, \q et sur la montagne d’Éphraïm et en Galaad il se rassasiera.
fr.B: Je ramènerai Israël vers son pâturage, \q et il paîtra sur le Carmel et dans le Bashân ; \q dans les collines d’Éphraïm et en Galaad, il mangera à satiété.
fr.R: Mais je ramènerai le peuple d’Israël dans son pays, comme des brebis dans leur pâturage. \q Il mangera sur le mont Carmel et dans le Bashân. \q Il mangera autant qu’il voudra dans les collines d’Éphraïm et en Galaad.

sw.L: Nami nitamrudisha Israeli katika malisho yake, \q naye atakula Karmeli na Bashani, \q na katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu na Gileadi nafsi yake itashiba.
sw.B: Nitamrudisha Israeli katika malisho yake mwenyewe, \q naye atakula Karmeli na Bashani; \q katika vilima vya Efraimu na Gileadi atakula na kushiba.
sw.R: Lakini nitawarudisha watu wa Israeli katika nchi yao wenyewe, kama kondoo katika malisho yao. \q Watakula juu ya mlima Karmeli na huko Bashani. \q Watakula kila wanachotaka katika vilima vya Efraimu na huko Gileadi.

vi.L: Ta sẽ đem Y-sơ-ra-ên trở về đồng cỏ của nó, \q và nó sẽ ăn cỏ trên Cạt-mên và Ba-san, \q và trên đồi núi Ép-ra-im và tại Ga-la-át, lòng nó sẽ được thỏa mãn.
vi.B: Ta sẽ đem Y-sơ-ra-ên trở về đồng cỏ của nó, \q và nó sẽ ăn cỏ trên Cạt-mên và tại Ba-san; \q trên các đồi Ép-ra-im và tại Ga-la-át nó sẽ được no nê.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem dân Y-sơ-ra-ên trở về xứ của họ, như chiên trở về đồng cỏ. \q Họ sẽ ăn uống trên núi Cạt-mên và tại Ba-san. \q Họ sẽ ăn no nê trên các đồi Ép-ra-im và tại Ga-la-át.

decisions.choice: Carmel, Bashan, Ephraim, Gilead: the richest grazing land of the north
decisions.reason: Carmel is the wooded ridge by the sea; Bashan, east of the Sea of Galilee, was famous for its cattle (Amos 4:1); the hill country of Ephraim is the heart of the old northern kingdom; Gilead lies east of the Jordan. These were among the first lands lost to Assyria (2 Kings 15:29), and they are promised back.

decisions.choice: Bashan and Gilead: as in Micah's prayer
decisions.reason: Micah prays that God will shepherd his flock "in Bashan and Gilead as in the days of old" (Micah 7:14). The same hope is given here.

decisions.choice: his appetite will be satisfied: he will eat his fill
decisions.reason: The word often translated "soul" here means desire or appetite, the hunger of the sheep (31:14, 25). The flock that was devoured (verse 17) will itself be well fed.

decisions.choice: the people of Israel ... their own land, like sheep to their pasture ... Mount Carmel
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the sheep and its pasture and speaks of Israel as "them", as in verse 17.

source.text: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵם֩ וּבָעֵ֨ת הַהִ֜יא נְאֻם־יְהוָ֗ה יְבֻקַּ֞שׁ אֶת־עֲוֺ֤ן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאֵינֶ֔נּוּ וְאֶת־חַטֹּ֥את יְהוּדָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א תִמָּצֶ֑אינָה כִּ֥י אֶסְלַ֖ח לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר אַשְׁאִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: In the days those and in the time that, declares Yahweh, will be sought [the] iniquity of Israel, and there [will be] none, and [the] sins of Judah, and not they will be found, for I will pardon whom I leave as [a] remnant.

en.L: In those days and at that time, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the iniquity of Israel will be sought, and there will be none, \q and the sins of Judah, and they will not be found; \q for I will pardon those whom I leave as a remnant.
en.B: In those days, at that time, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the guilt of Israel will be searched for, but there will be none; \q the sins of Judah, but they will not be found; \q for I will forgive those I leave alive.
en.R: When that time comes, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, people will look for Israel's sin, but there will not be any. \q They will look for Judah's sins, but they will not find any, \q because I will forgive the people I let survive.

es.L: En aquellos días y en aquel tiempo, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, se buscará la iniquidad de Israel, y no la habrá, \q y los pecados de Judá, y no se hallarán; \q porque perdonaré a los que yo deje como remanente.
es.B: En aquellos días, en aquel tiempo, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, se buscará la culpa de Israel, pero no la habrá; \q los pecados de Judá, pero no se encontrarán; \q porque perdonaré a los que deje con vida.
es.R: Cuando llegue ese tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, la gente buscará el pecado de Israel, pero no habrá ninguno. \q Buscarán los pecados de Judá, pero no encontrarán ninguno, \q porque perdonaré a los que deje con vida.

fr.L: En ces jours-là et en ce temps-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, on cherchera l’iniquité d’Israël, et il n’y en aura pas, \q et les péchés de Juda, et on ne les trouvera pas ; \q car je pardonnerai à ceux que je laisserai comme reste.
fr.B: En ces jours-là, en ce temps-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, on cherchera la faute d’Israël, mais il n’y en aura plus ; \q les péchés de Juda, mais on ne les trouvera pas ; \q car je pardonnerai à ceux que je laisserai en vie.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, on cherchera le péché d’Israël, mais il n’y en aura plus. \q On cherchera les péchés de Juda, mais on n’en trouvera aucun, \q parce que je pardonnerai aux gens que je laisserai survivre.

sw.L: Katika siku zile na wakati ule, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uovu wa Israeli utatafutwa, wala hautakuwako, \q na dhambi za Yuda, wala hazitaonekana; \q kwa maana nitawasamehe wale nitakaowaacha kuwa mabaki.
sw.B: Katika siku zile, wakati ule, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hatia ya Israeli itatafutwa, lakini haitakuwako; \q dhambi za Yuda zitatafutwa, lakini hazitapatikana; \q kwa maana nitawasamehe wale nitakaowaacha hai.
sw.R: Wakati huo utakapofika, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, watu watatafuta dhambi ya Israeli, lakini haitakuwako. \q Watatafuta dhambi za Yuda, lakini hawatapata hata moja, \q kwa sababu nitawasamehe watu nitakaowaacha waishi.

vi.L: Trong những ngày ấy và vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, người ta sẽ tìm tội ác của Y-sơ-ra-ên mà không có, \q và tìm tội lỗi của Giu-đa mà không thấy; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tha thứ những kẻ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để lại làm người sót lại.
vi.B: Trong những ngày ấy, vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, người ta sẽ tìm lỗi lầm của Y-sơ-ra-ên nhưng chẳng còn; \q tìm tội lỗi của Giu-đa nhưng chẳng thấy; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tha thứ những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chừa lại.
vi.R: Khi thời ấy đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, người ta sẽ tìm tội lỗi của Y-sơ-ra-ên nhưng không có. \q Người ta sẽ tìm tội lỗi của Giu-đa nhưng không thấy, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tha thứ những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để cho sống sót.

decisions.choice: sought and not found: forgiveness that removes sin entirely
decisions.reason: No one searching will find the people's sin, because God has forgiven it (31:34; 33:8; Micah 7:18-19). The words echo the promise of the new covenant, "I will remember their sin no more".

decisions.choice: those whom I leave: the remnant who survive
decisions.reason: The verb means to leave over, to let survive. The remnant is the people God has kept through the judgment (23:3; 31:7).

decisions.choice: iniquity (L), guilt (B), sin (R); pardon (L), forgive (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for the word for iniquity. Balanced and Readable say "forgive" for the verb, which is used only of God's forgiving.

decisions.choice: people will look for ... they will not find
decisions.reason: Readable makes the passive verbs active with "people" as the subject, and joins the two phrases for the time, as in verse 4.

source.text: עַל־הָאָ֤רֶץ מְרָתַ֨יִם֙ עֲלֵ֣ה עָלֶ֔יהָ וְאֶל־יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י פְּק֑וֹד חֲרֹ֨ב וְהַחֲרֵ֤ם אַֽחֲרֵיהֶם֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה וַעֲשֵׂ֕ה כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Against the land of Merathaim, go up against her, and against [the] inhabitants of Pekod; kill and devote [them to destruction] after them, declares Yahweh, and do according to all that I have commanded you.

en.L: Against the land of Merathaim, go up against it, \q and against the inhabitants of Pekod. \q Kill and devote them to destruction to the last, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and do according to all that I have commanded you.
en.B: Go up against the land of Merathaim, \q and against those who live in Pekod. \q Kill them and devote them to destruction to the very last, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q do everything I have commanded you.
en.R: Attack Merathaim, the land of double rebellion! \q Attack the people who live in Pekod, the place of punishment! \q Kill them, and destroy every one of them completely, as given over to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Do everything I have told you to do.

es.L: Contra la tierra de Meratáyim, sube contra ella, \q y contra los habitantes de Pecod. \q Mata y destrúyelos por completo hasta el último, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q y haz conforme a todo lo que te he mandado.
es.B: Sube contra la tierra de Meratáyim \q y contra los que viven en Pecod. \q Mátalos y entrégalos a la destrucción hasta el último, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q haz todo lo que te he mandado.
es.R: ¡Ataca a Meratáyim, la tierra de la doble rebelión! \q ¡Ataca a los que viven en Pecod, el lugar del castigo! \q Mátalos y destrúyelos a todos por completo, como cosa entregada a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Haz todo lo que te he dicho.

fr.L: Contre le pays de Merathaïm, monte contre lui, \q et contre les habitants de Peqod. \q Tue et voue-les à l’interdit jusqu’au dernier, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et fais selon tout ce que je t’ai commandé.
fr.B: Monte contre le pays de Merathaïm \q et contre les habitants de Peqod. \q Tue-les et voue-les à l’interdit jusqu’au dernier, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q fais tout ce que je t’ai commandé.
fr.R: Attaque Merathaïm, le pays de la double révolte ! \q Attaque les habitants de Peqod, le lieu de la punition ! \q Tue-les et détruis-les tous complètement, comme ce qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}est consacré, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Fais tout ce que je t’ai dit de faire.

sw.L: Juu ya nchi ya Merathaimu, panda juu yake, \q na juu ya wakaaji wa Pekodi. \q Waue na kuwaangamiza kabisa mpaka wa mwisho, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q ukafanye sawasawa na yote niliyokuamuru.
sw.B: Panda juu ya nchi ya Merathaimu, \q na juu ya wale wanaoishi Pekodi. \q Waue na kuwaangamiza kabisa mpaka wa mwisho, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q fanya kila kitu nilichokuamuru.
sw.R: Ishambulie Merathaimu, nchi ya uasi mara mbili! \q Washambulie watu wanaoishi Pekodi, mahali pa adhabu! \q Waue, uwaangamize kabisa kila mmoja wao, kama vitu vilivyotolewa {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Fanya kila kitu nilichokuambia ufanye.

vi.L: Hãy đi lên đánh xứ Mê-ra-tha-im, \q và đánh dân cư Phê-cốt. \q Hãy giết và tận diệt chúng đến kẻ sau cùng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q và hãy làm theo mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho ngươi.
vi.B: Hãy đi lên đánh xứ Mê-ra-tha-im, \q và đánh những kẻ sống tại Phê-cốt. \q Hãy giết chúng và tận diệt chúng cho đến kẻ sau cùng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy; \q hãy làm mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho ngươi.
vi.R: Hãy tấn công Mê-ra-tha-im, xứ phản loạn gấp đôi! \q Hãy tấn công dân sống tại Phê-cốt, nơi chịu hình phạt! \q Hãy giết chúng, và tiêu diệt hết thảy, như vật đã dâng hiến cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. \q Hãy làm mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã bảo ngươi làm.

decisions.choice: Merathaim and Pekod: real names turned into wordplay
decisions.reason: Merathaim means "double rebellion" (or "double bitterness"), and Pekod sounds like the word for "punishment" or "visitation" (as in verses 18, 27 and 31). Both seem to play on real names: Babylonian texts call the marshy land at the head of the Persian Gulf "the land of the Bitter River" (mat marrati), and the Puqudu were an Aramean people living east of Babylon, named as Pekod in Ezekiel 23:23. So Babylon is called the land of double rebellion and the people of punishment.

decisions.choice: devote them to destruction: the ban of holy war
decisions.reason: To devote something to destruction was to give it over wholly to God, so that nothing was kept back for one's own use (Deuteronomy 7:2; Joshua 6:17). God once used Babylon to do this to Judah (25:9); now Babylon is put under the ban. "After them" means pursuing them to the last.

decisions.choice: go up ... do ...: commands to one attacker
decisions.reason: The commands are singular: God speaks to the leader of the attacking army, or to the army as one. "All that I have commanded you" shows that the attacker carries out God's orders (verse 25; Isaiah 13:3-5).

decisions.choice: devote ... to destruction (L, B); destroy ... completely, as given over to me (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for the ban; Readable explains it, as the terms list says.

decisions.choice: the land of double rebellion ... the place of punishment
decisions.reason: Readable adds the meaning of each name, so that the reader can hear the wordplay (meaning decision m1). The meanings are added beside the names, not in place of them.

decisions.choice: sube, mata, haz (singular)
decisions.reason: The commands in this verse are singular in the Hebrew, spoken to the attacker as one; Spanish uses "tú".

decisions.choice: Meratáyim, Pecod
decisions.reason: Merathaim ("double rebellion") and Pekod ("punishment") are names of a region and a people of Babylonia, with a play on their meaning that Readable spells out.

decisions.choice: "kuwaangamiza kabisa" (L, B); "uwaangamize kabisa ..., kama vitu vilivyotolewa kwangu" (R)
decisions.reason: The ban of holy war gave people or things over to God by destroying them; Swahili "kuangamiza kabisa" carries the destruction, and Readable adds the giving over to God, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "voue-les à l’interdit" (L, B); "détruis-les tous complètement, comme ce qui m’est consacré" (R)
decisions.reason: *Ḥerem* as the earlier French books render it ("vouer à l’interdit"); Readable explains it as the English does.

decisions.choice: Mê-ra-tha-im, Phê-cốt; tận diệt (L, B), tiêu diệt hết thảy, như vật đã dâng hiến cho Ta (R)
decisions.reason: New names, with their meanings given at Readable as the English does. The ban (*herem*) is "tận diệt" at Literal and Balanced; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: [A] sound of battle in the land, and destruction great.

en.L: A sound of battle in the land, \q and great destruction!
en.B: The noise of battle is in the land, \q and great destruction!
en.R: Listen! The noise of battle is in the land. \q Everything is being destroyed.

es.L: ¡Estruendo de guerra en la tierra, \q y gran destrucción!
es.B: ¡Hay estruendo de batalla en la tierra, \q y gran destrucción!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}! Hay ruido de batalla en la tierra. \q Todo está siendo destruido.

fr.L: Un bruit de guerre dans le pays, \q et un grand désastre !
fr.B: Le fracas de la guerre est dans le pays, \q et un grand désastre !
fr.R: Écoutez ! Le bruit de la bataille remplit le pays. \q Tout est en train d’être détruit.

sw.L: Sauti ya vita katika nchi, \q na maangamizi makuu!
sw.B: Kelele za vita zimo katika nchi, \q na maangamizi makuu!
sw.R: Sikilizeni! Kelele za vita zimo katika nchi. \q Kila kitu kinaangamizwa.

vi.L: Có tiếng chiến trận trong xứ, \q và sự hủy diệt lớn!
vi.B: Tiếng chiến trận vang lên trong xứ, \q và sự hủy diệt lớn lao!
vi.R: Hãy nghe! Tiếng chiến trận vang lên trong xứ. \q Mọi thứ đang bị hủy diệt.

decisions.choice: great destruction: the cry once raised over Judah
decisions.reason: "Great destruction" was the alarm over Judah (4:6; 6:1) and over Moab (48:3). Now it is heard in Babylon.

decisions.choice: a sound of battle: an exclamation
decisions.reason: The line has no verb. It is a cry, as if the hearer is called to listen to the battle already raging.

decisions.choice: Listen! ... Everything is being destroyed.
decisions.reason: Readable makes the cry into short sentences and says what "great destruction" means.

source.text: אֵ֤יךְ נִגְדַּע֙ וַיִּשָּׁבֵ֔ר פַּטִּ֖ישׁ כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֵ֣יךְ הָיְתָ֧ה לְשַׁמָּ֛ה בָּבֶ֖ל בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: How has been cut down and broken [the] hammer of all the earth! How has become [a] horror Babylon among the nations!

en.L: How the hammer of the whole earth \q has been cut down and broken! \q How Babylon has become a horror among the nations!
en.B: How the hammer of the whole earth \q is cut down and shattered! \q How Babylon has become a horror among the nations!
en.R: Babylon was like a hammer that beat down the whole earth, \q but now it has been cut down and broken! \q The nations are horrified at what has happened to Babylon!

es.L: ¡Cómo ha sido cortado y quebrado \q el martillo de toda la tierra! \q ¡Cómo se ha convertido Babilonia en objeto de horror entre las naciones!
es.B: ¡Cómo ha sido cortado y destrozado \q el martillo de toda la tierra! \q ¡Cómo se ha convertido Babilonia en un horror entre las naciones!
es.R: Babilonia era como un martillo que golpeaba toda la tierra, \q ¡pero ahora ha sido cortado y quebrado! \q ¡Las naciones se horrorizan de lo que le ha pasado a Babilonia!

fr.L: Comme il a été abattu et brisé, \q le marteau de toute la terre ! \q Comme Babylone est devenue un objet d’horreur parmi les nations !
fr.B: Comme il est abattu et brisé, \q le marteau de toute la terre ! \q Comme Babylone est devenue un objet d’horreur parmi les nations !
fr.R: Babylone était comme un marteau qui frappait toute la terre, \q mais maintenant elle a été abattue et brisée ! \q Les nations sont horrifiées par ce qui est arrivé à Babylone !

sw.L: Jinsi nyundo ya dunia yote \q ilivyokatwa na kuvunjika! \q Jinsi Babeli ilivyokuwa kitisho kati ya mataifa!
sw.B: Jinsi nyundo ya dunia yote \q ilivyokatwa na kuvunjwavunjwa! \q Jinsi Babeli ilivyokuwa kitisho kati ya mataifa!
sw.R: Babeli ilikuwa kama nyundo iliyoipiga dunia yote, \q lakini sasa imekatwa na kuvunjika! \q Mataifa yanashangaa kwa hofu kwa yale yaliyoipata Babeli!

vi.L: Cây búa của cả trái đất \q đã bị chặt đứt và bẻ gãy thể nào! \q Ba-by-lôn đã thành điều kinh hoàng giữa các dân tộc thể nào!
vi.B: Cây búa của cả trái đất \q đã bị chặt gãy và đập tan thể nào! \q Ba-by-lôn đã thành điều kinh hoàng giữa các dân tộc thể nào!
vi.R: Ba-by-lôn từng như cây búa đập nát cả trái đất, \q nhưng nay nó đã bị chặt đứt và bẻ gãy! \q Các dân tộc kinh hãi khi thấy điều đã xảy đến cho Ba-by-lôn!

decisions.choice: the hammer of the whole earth: the power that smashed the nations
decisions.reason: Babylon is pictured as a smith's hammer that broke every nation it struck. In 51:20-23 God calls it his war club, with which he shattered nations. Now the hammer itself is broken.

decisions.choice: How ...!: a cry of lament and of wonder
decisions.reason: The word begins laments (Lamentations 1:1; 2 Samuel 1:19) and mocking songs over fallen tyrants (Isaiah 14:4, 12). Here it mourns, with irony, Babylon's fall.

decisions.choice: a horror: a ruin that stuns all who see it
decisions.reason: As in 25:11 and verse 13, the word means a desolation and the horror it causes.

decisions.choice: was like a hammer that beat down ... The nations are horrified
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the hammer and says the cry over Babylon in plain words.

source.text: יָקֹ֨שְׁתִּי לָ֤ךְ וְגַם־נִלְכַּדְתְּ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאַ֖תְּ לֹ֣א יָדָ֑עַתְּ נִמְצֵאת֙ וְגַם־נִתְפַּ֔שְׂתְּ כִּ֥י בַֽיהוָ֖ה הִתְגָּרִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: I laid [a] snare for you, and also you were caught, Babylon, and you not knew; you were found and also seized, for against Yahweh you strove.

en.L: I set a snare for you, and you were caught, Babylon, \q and you did not know it; \q you were found and also seized, \q because you contended against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I laid a trap for you, Babylon, and it caught you \q before you were aware of it. \q You were found out and seized, \q because you fought against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Babylon, I set a trap for you, \q and you were caught before you knew what was happening. \q You were found and captured, \q because you fought against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Te puse lazo, y fuiste atrapada, Babilonia, \q y tú no lo supiste; \q fuiste hallada y también apresada, \q porque contendiste contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Te tendí una trampa, Babilonia, y caíste en ella \q sin darte cuenta. \q Fuiste descubierta y apresada, \q porque luchaste contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Babilonia, te puse una trampa, \q y caíste en ella antes de saber lo que pasaba. \q Te encontraron y te capturaron, \q porque luchaste contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Je t’ai tendu un piège, et tu as été prise, Babylone, \q et tu ne le savais pas ; \q tu as été trouvée et même saisie, \q parce que tu t’es attaquée {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je t’ai tendu un piège, Babylone, et tu y as été prise \q sans t’en rendre compte. \q Tu as été découverte et saisie, \q parce que tu as combattu {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Babylone, je t’ai tendu un piège, \q et tu as été prise avant de comprendre ce qui se passait. \q On t’a trouvée et capturée, \q parce que tu as combattu {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nimekutegea mtego, nawe umenaswa, ewe Babeli, \q wala hukujua; \q umeonekana na kukamatwa pia, \q kwa sababu ulishindana na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nilikutegea mtego, ewe Babeli, nao ukakunasa \q kabla hujatambua. \q Ulionekana na kukamatwa, \q kwa sababu ulipigana na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ewe Babeli, nilikutegea mtego, \q nawe ukanaswa kabla hujajua kinachotokea. \q Ulipatikana na kukamatwa, \q kwa sababu ulipigana na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ta đã gài bẫy cho ngươi, và ngươi đã bị mắc, hỡi Ba-by-lôn, \q mà ngươi không hề biết; \q ngươi đã bị tìm thấy và bị bắt, \q vì ngươi đã tranh chiến nghịch cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Hỡi Ba-by-lôn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã gài bẫy cho ngươi, và ngươi đã sa vào \q trước khi ngươi kịp biết. \q Ngươi đã bị phát hiện và bị bắt, \q vì ngươi đã chống lại {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Hỡi Ba-by-lôn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã gài bẫy cho ngươi, \q và ngươi đã sa vào trước khi biết chuyện gì xảy ra. \q Ngươi đã bị tìm ra và bị bắt, \q vì ngươi đã chống lại {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

decisions.choice: I set a snare: God himself traps Babylon
decisions.reason: The hunter's snare is a picture of sudden capture (5:26; Lamentations 3:52). God speaks: the city did not fall by chance, and it was taken by surprise. Babylon fell in 539 BC without a long siege.

decisions.choice: you contended against the LORD: you challenged him
decisions.reason: The verb means to stir up strife, to pick a fight (Deuteronomy 2:5, 9). By its pride and its treatment of God's people, Babylon made itself God's opponent (verse 29).

decisions.choice: you were caught ... found ... seized: past tense of what is certain
decisions.reason: As in verses 2-3, the verbs speak of the capture as already done.

decisions.choice: Babylon, and you were caught before you knew it
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the name next to "you" and join "you did not know it" to the capture.

source.text: פָּתַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת־א֣וֹצָר֔וֹ וַיּוֹצֵ֖א אֶת־כְּלֵ֣י זַעְמ֑וֹ כִּי־מְלָאכָ֣ה הִ֗יא לַֽאדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Has opened Yahweh his armory, and has brought out [the] weapons of his indignation, for [a] work it [is] of [the] Lord Yahweh of hosts in [the] land of [the] Chaldeans.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has opened {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} armory \q and has brought out the weapons of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} indignation, \q for this is a work of the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has opened {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} armory \q and brought out the weapons of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wrath, \q for the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies has work to do in the land of the Chaldeans.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has opened the room where {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} weapons are kept. \q He has brought out the weapons {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} uses when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is angry. \q The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies has work to do in the land of the Babylonians.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha abierto {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} arsenal \q y ha sacado las armas de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} indignación, \q porque esta es obra del Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos en la tierra de los caldeos.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha abierto {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} arsenal \q y ha sacado las armas de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira, \q porque el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos tiene una obra que hacer en la tierra de los caldeos.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha abierto el lugar donde guarda {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} armas. \q Ha sacado las armas que usa cuando está enojado. \q El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos tiene una obra que hacer en la tierra de los babilonios.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a ouvert {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} arsenal \q et a fait sortir les armes de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fureur, \q car c’est une œuvre du Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées au pays des Chaldéens.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a ouvert {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} arsenal \q et en a sorti les armes de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère, \q car le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées a une œuvre à accomplir au pays des Chaldéens.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a ouvert la salle où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} garde {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} armes. \q Il a sorti les armes dont {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se sert quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est en colère. \q Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées a du travail à faire au pays des Babyloniens.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefungua ghala {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} la silaha, \q na kuzitoa silaha za ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q kwa maana hii ni kazi ya Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi katika nchi ya Wakaldayo.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefungua ghala {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} la silaha \q na kuzitoa silaha za ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q kwa maana Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ana kazi ya kufanya katika nchi ya Wakaldayo.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefungua chumba ambamo silaha {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zinawekwa. \q Amezitoa silaha anazozitumia anapokasirika. \q Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ana kazi ya kufanya katika nchi ya Wababeli.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã mở kho vũ khí {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và đem ra các khí giới của cơn phẫn nộ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q vì đây là công việc của Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân trong xứ của người Canh-đê.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã mở kho vũ khí {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và đem ra các khí giới của cơn thịnh nộ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q vì Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân có việc phải làm trong xứ của người Canh-đê.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã mở kho chứa vũ khí của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài đã đem ra các vũ khí {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dùng khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận. \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân có việc phải làm trong xứ của người Ba-by-lôn.

decisions.choice: his armory ... the weapons of his indignation: the nations God uses to punish
decisions.reason: The word means a storehouse; here it holds weapons. The same phrase, "the weapons of his indignation", names the armies God gathers against Babylon in Isaiah 13:5. The weapons are the attacking nations.

decisions.choice: a work: a task God has to carry out
decisions.reason: The word is used of work to be done (48:10). The judgment of Babylon is God's own work, which he will finish.

decisions.choice: the Lord GOD of hosts: the master of every army
decisions.reason: The title joins "Lord" with the divine name and "of hosts" (2:19). The armies at Babylon's gates come because the commander of all armies has sent them.

decisions.choice: the Lord GOD of hosts (L), of Armies (B, R); Chaldeans (L, B), Babylonians (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for these titles and names. Readable explains "armory" and "weapons of indignation".

source.text: בֹּֽאוּ־לָ֤הּ מִקֵּץ֙ פִּתְח֣וּ מַאֲבֻסֶ֔יהָ סָלּ֥וּהָ כְמוֹ־עֲרֵמִ֖ים וְהַחֲרִימ֑וּהָ אַל־תְּהִי־לָ֖הּ שְׁאֵרִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: Come against her from [the] end; open her granaries; pile her up like heaps, and devote her [to destruction]; not let there be for her [a] remnant.

en.L: Come against her from every border; open her granaries; \q pile her up like heaps of grain and devote her to destruction; \q let nothing be left of her.
en.B: Come against her from the farthest places; break open her storehouses; \q pile her up like heaps of grain and devote her to destruction. \q Leave nothing of her.
en.R: Come and attack Babylon from far away. Break open its storehouses. \q Pile everything up like heaps of grain, and destroy it completely, as given over to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Do not let anything be left.

es.L: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} contra ella desde los confines; {{plural_you:abran|abrid}} sus graneros; \q {{plural_you:amontónenla|amontonadla}} como montones de grano y {{plural_you:destrúyanla|destruidla}} por completo; \q que no le quede nada.
es.B: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} contra ella desde los lugares más lejanos; {{plural_you:abran|abrid}} sus graneros; \q {{plural_you:amontónenla|amontonadla}} como montones de grano y {{plural_you:entréguenla|entregadla}} a la destrucción. \q No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} nada de ella.
es.R: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} desde lejos y {{plural_you:ataquen|atacad}} a Babilonia. {{plural_you:Abran|Abrid}} sus graneros. \q {{plural_you:Amontonen|Amontonad}} todo como montones de grano y {{plural_you:destrúyanlo|destruidlo}} por completo, como cosa entregada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. \q No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que quede nada.

fr.L: Venez contre elle de toutes les frontières ; ouvrez ses greniers ; \q entassez-la comme des tas de grain et vouez-la à l’interdit ; \q qu’il ne reste rien d’elle.
fr.B: Venez contre elle des extrémités de la terre ; forcez ses greniers ; \q entassez-la comme des monceaux de grain et vouez-la à l’interdit. \q Ne laissez rien d’elle.
fr.R: Venez attaquer Babylone depuis les pays lointains. Forcez ses entrepôts. \q Entassez tout comme des tas de grain, et détruisez tout complètement, comme ce qui est consacré {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. \q Ne laissez rien.

sw.L: Njooni juu yake kutoka kila mpaka; zifungueni ghala zake; \q mrundikeni kama marundo ya nafaka, mkamwangamize kabisa; \q asibakiwe na kitu.
sw.B: Njooni juu yake kutoka mahali pa mbali kabisa; zivunjeni ghala zake; \q mrundikeni kama marundo ya nafaka, mkamwangamize kabisa. \q Msimwachie chochote.
sw.R: Njooni mkaishambulie Babeli kutoka mbali. Zivunjeni ghala zake. \q Rundikeni kila kitu kama marundo ya nafaka, mkaviangamize kabisa, kama vitu vilivyotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Msiache kitu chochote kibaki.

vi.L: Hãy từ mọi biên cương đến đánh nó; hãy mở các kho lúa nó; \q hãy chất nó thành đống như đống lúa và tận diệt nó; \q đừng để sót lại gì của nó.
vi.B: Hãy từ những nơi xa xôi nhất đến đánh nó; hãy phá các kho lẫm nó; \q hãy chất nó thành đống như đống lúa và tận diệt nó. \q Đừng chừa lại gì của nó.
vi.R: Hãy từ phương xa đến tấn công Ba-by-lôn. Hãy phá các kho chứa của nó. \q Hãy chất mọi thứ thành đống như đống lúa, và tiêu diệt hết như vật đã dâng hiến cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Đừng để sót lại gì cả.

decisions.choice: from the end: from every border, from the farthest places
decisions.reason: "From the end" can mean from the far ends of the earth (verse 41) or from every side of the city (51:31). Either way, the attackers are to come from everywhere at once.

decisions.choice: granaries ... heaps: her stores of grain, and the heaps that she will become
decisions.reason: The word for "granaries" is used only here; it comes from a word for feeding animals, and so means storehouses of grain. The heaps are heaps of grain, as on a threshing floor (Ruth 3:7), and also perhaps the heaps of rubble a ruined city becomes (Nehemiah 3:34).

decisions.choice: devote her to destruction: as in verse 21
decisions.reason: Everything is to be given over wholly to God, and nothing kept back (Joshua 6:17).

decisions.choice: destroy it completely, as given over to the LORD; from far away
decisions.reason: The settled Readable wording for the ban, as in verse 21.

decisions.choice: destrúyanla por completo (L); entréguenla a la destrucción (B); destrúyanlo por completo, como cosa entregada al SEÑOR (R)
decisions.reason: *Ḥerem*, the ban: what is devoted to God is wholly destroyed; Readable says what it means.

source.text: חִרְבוּ֙ כָּל־פָּרֶ֔יהָ יֵרְד֖וּ לַטָּ֑בַח ה֣וֹי עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־בָ֥א יוֹמָ֖ם עֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Kill all her young bulls; let them go down to the slaughter; woe on them, for has come their day, [the] time of their punishment.

en.L: Kill all her young bulls; \q let them go down to the slaughter. \q Woe on them, \q for their day has come, the time of their punishment.
en.B: Kill all her young bulls; \q let them go down to be slaughtered. \q Woe to them, \q for their day has arrived, the time for them to be punished.
en.R: Kill all of Babylon's young soldiers, strong as young bulls. \q Let them be slaughtered like animals. \q How terrible it will be for them! \q The time has come for them to be punished.

es.L: {{plural_you:Maten|Matad}} a todos sus novillos; \q que desciendan al matadero. \q ¡Ay de ellos, \q porque ha llegado su día, el tiempo de su castigo!
es.B: {{plural_you:Maten|Matad}} a todos sus novillos; \q que bajen al matadero. \q ¡Ay de ellos, \q porque ha llegado su día, el tiempo de su castigo!
es.R: {{plural_you:Maten|Matad}} a todos los jóvenes soldados de Babilonia, fuertes como novillos. \q Que los maten como a animales. \q ¡Qué terrible será para ellos! \q Ha llegado el tiempo de su castigo.

fr.L: Tuez tous ses jeunes taureaux ; \q qu’ils descendent au carnage. \q Malheur, eux ! \q car leur jour est venu, le temps de leur châtiment.
fr.B: Tuez tous ses jeunes taureaux ; \q qu’ils descendent à la boucherie. \q Malheur à eux, \q car leur jour est arrivé, le temps où ils seront punis.
fr.R: Tuez tous les jeunes soldats de Babylone, forts comme de jeunes taureaux. \q Qu’on les égorge comme des bêtes. \q Quel malheur pour eux ! \q Le moment est venu de les punir.

sw.L: Waueni mafahali wake wachanga wote; \q na washuke machinjoni. \q Ole wao, \q kwa maana siku yao imefika, wakati wa kuadhibiwa kwao.
sw.B: Waueni mafahali wake wachanga wote; \q na washuke kuchinjwa. \q Ole wao, \q kwa maana siku yao imefika, wakati wao wa kuadhibiwa.
sw.R: Waueni askari vijana wote wa Babeli, walio na nguvu kama mafahali wachanga. \q Wachinjwe kama wanyama. \q Itakuwa vibaya sana kwao! \q Wakati umefika wa wao kuadhibiwa.

vi.L: Hãy giết hết các bò đực tơ của nó; \q hãy để chúng xuống chỗ bị tàn sát. \q Khốn cho chúng, \q vì ngày của chúng đã đến, là thời kỳ chúng bị phạt.
vi.B: Hãy giết hết các bò đực tơ của nó; \q hãy để chúng xuống chỗ bị làm thịt. \q Khốn cho chúng, \q vì ngày của chúng đã đến, là lúc chúng bị trừng phạt.
vi.R: Hãy giết hết các thanh niên lính chiến của Ba-by-lôn, mạnh như bò đực tơ. \q Hãy để chúng bị giết như súc vật. \q Thật khốn khổ cho chúng! \q Đã đến lúc chúng bị trừng phạt.

decisions.choice: her young bulls: her strong young warriors
decisions.reason: Young bulls are a picture of strong fighting men and leaders (46:21; Isaiah 34:7; Psalm 22:13). They will be led to slaughter as animals are.

decisions.choice: their day, the time of their punishment: the day God has set to judge them
decisions.reason: The word for "punishment" is the noun of the verb "visit" (verse 18): the time when God calls them to account (46:21; 48:44).

decisions.choice: Woe on them (L); Woe to them (B); How terrible it will be for them (R)
decisions.reason: The book's wording for the cry of woe, as in Isaiah. Readable explains the young bulls as soldiers (meaning decision m1).

source.text: ק֥וֹל נָסִ֛ים וּפְלֵטִ֖ים מֵאֶ֣רֶץ בָּבֶ֑ל לְהַגִּ֣יד בְּצִיּ֗וֹן אֶת־נִקְמַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ נִקְמַ֖ת הֵיכָלֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] sound of fugitives and escapees from [the] land of Babylon, to declare in Zion [the] vengeance of Yahweh our God, [the] vengeance of his temple.

en.L: The sound of those who flee and escape from the land of Babylon, \q to declare in Zion the vengeance of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, \q the vengeance for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple!
en.B: Listen! Fugitives and refugees are coming from the land of Babylon \q to tell in Zion of the vengeance of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, \q vengeance for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple.
en.R: Listen! People are escaping from Babylon. \q They are running to Zion to tell how {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God has paid Babylon back. \q He has paid it back for destroying {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple.

es.L: ¡Voz de los que huyen y escapan de la tierra de Babilonia, \q para anunciar en Sion la venganza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, \q la venganza por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo!
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}! Fugitivos y refugiados vienen de la tierra de Babilonia \q para anunciar en Sion la venganza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, \q la venganza por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}! Hay gente que escapa de Babilonia. \q Corren a Sion a contar cómo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios le dio su merecido a Babilonia. \q Le dio su merecido por haber destruido {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo.

fr.L: La voix de ceux qui fuient et s’échappent du pays de Babylone, \q pour annoncer dans Sion la vengeance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu, \q la vengeance de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple !
fr.B: Écoutez ! Des fuyards et des rescapés arrivent du pays de Babylone \q pour raconter dans Sion la vengeance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu, \q la vengeance pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple.
fr.R: Écoutez ! Des gens s’échappent de Babylone. \q Ils courent à Sion raconter comment {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu a fait payer Babylone. \q Il lui a fait payer la destruction de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple.

sw.L: Sauti ya wale wanaokimbia na kuokoka kutoka nchi ya Babeli, \q kutangaza katika Sayuni kisasi cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, \q kisasi cha hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}!
sw.B: Sikilizeni! Wakimbizi na watu waliookoka wanakuja kutoka nchi ya Babeli \q kutangaza katika Sayuni kisasi cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, \q kisasi kwa ajili ya hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: Sikilizeni! Watu wanatoroka kutoka Babeli. \q Wanakimbia mpaka Sayuni kueleza jinsi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu alivyoilipiza Babeli. \q Ameilipiza kwa kuliharibu hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.

vi.L: Có tiếng những kẻ chạy trốn và thoát khỏi xứ Ba-by-lôn, \q để rao báo tại Si-ôn sự báo thù của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, \q sự báo thù cho đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.B: Hãy nghe! Những kẻ chạy trốn và thoát nạn đang đến từ xứ Ba-by-lôn \q để thuật lại tại Si-ôn về sự báo thù của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, \q sự báo thù cho đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Hãy nghe! Có những người đang trốn thoát khỏi Ba-by-lôn. \q Họ chạy về Si-ôn để kể lại {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, đã báo trả Ba-by-lôn thế nào. \q Ngài đã báo trả nó vì đã phá hủy đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: the sound of: Listen!
decisions.reason: The word "sound" or "voice" at the start of a line is often a cry to listen (3:21; 4:15; verse 22).

decisions.choice: fugitives ... our God: God's people escaping home
decisions.reason: Those who flee are the exiles of verse 8, getting away as Babylon falls. They bring the news to Zion, and the words "our God" are theirs.

decisions.choice: vengeance for his temple: repayment for its destruction
decisions.reason: Babylon burned the temple in Jerusalem (52:13) and carried off its treasures (52:17-23). Its fall is God's answer to that crime (51:11).

decisions.choice: paid Babylon back ... for destroying his temple
decisions.reason: Readable says "paid back" for vengeance (verse 15) and says what was done to the temple.

source.text: הַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ אֶל־בָּבֶ֣ל׀רַ֠בִּים כָּל־דֹּ֨רְכֵי קֶ֜שֶׁת חֲנ֧וּ עָלֶ֣יהָ סָבִ֗יב אַל־יְהִי־לָהּ֙פְּלֵטָ֔ה שַׁלְּמוּ־לָ֣הּ כְּפָעֳלָ֔הּ כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשְׂתָ֖ה עֲשׂוּ־לָ֑הּ כִּ֧י אֶל־יְהוָ֛ה זָ֖דָה אֶל־קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Summon against Babylon archers, all bending [the] bow; encamp against her all around; not let there be for her escape; repay her according to her deed[s]; according to all that she has done, do to her; for against Yahweh she has been arrogant, against [the] Holy One of Israel.

en.L: Summon archers against Babylon, all who bend the bow; encamp against her all around; let there be no escape for her. \q Repay her according to her deeds; \q do to her according to all that she has done, \q for she has acted arrogantly against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, against the Holy One of Israel.
en.B: Call up archers against Babylon, all who draw the bow. Camp all around her; let no one escape. \q Pay her back for what she has done; \q do to her just as she has done, \q for she has defied {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in her pride, the Holy One of Israel.
en.R: Call for soldiers with bows to attack Babylon. Put your camps all around the city. Do not let anyone escape. \q Pay Babylon back for what it has done. \q Do to it what it did to others. \q It was proud and defied {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the Holy One of Israel.

es.L: {{plural_you:Convoquen|Convocad}} contra Babilonia a los arqueros, a todos los que tensan el arco; {{plural_you:acampen|acampad}} contra ella alrededor; que no haya escape para ella. \q {{plural_you:Páguenle|Pagadle}} conforme a su obra; \q conforme a todo lo que ella hizo, {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} con ella, \q porque se ensoberbeció contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, contra el Santo de Israel.
es.B: {{plural_you:Llamen|Llamad}} a los arqueros contra Babilonia, a todos los que tensan el arco. {{plural_you:Acampen|Acampad}} alrededor de ella; que nadie escape. \q {{plural_you:Páguenle|Pagadle}} por lo que ha hecho; \q {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} con ella lo mismo que ella hizo, \q porque desafió con soberbia {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, al Santo de Israel.
es.R: {{plural_you:Llamen|Llamad}} a los soldados con arcos para que ataquen a Babilonia. {{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}} {{plural_you:sus campamentos|vuestros campamentos}} alrededor de la ciudad. No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que nadie escape. \q {{plural_you:Denle|Dadle}} a Babilonia su merecido por lo que ha hecho. \q {{plural_you:Háganle|Hacedle}} lo que ella les hizo a otros. \q Fue orgullosa y desafió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Santo de Israel.

fr.L: Convoquez contre Babylone les archers, tous ceux qui tendent l’arc ; campez contre elle tout autour ; qu’il n’y ait pas de rescapé pour elle. \q Rendez-lui selon ses œuvres ; \q faites-lui selon tout ce qu’elle a fait, \q car elle s’est montrée arrogante envers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, envers le Saint d’Israël.
fr.B: Appelez des archers contre Babylone, tous ceux qui tendent l’arc. Campez tout autour d’elle ; que personne n’échappe. \q Rendez-lui ce qu’elle a fait ; \q faites-lui exactement ce qu’elle a fait, \q car dans son orgueil elle a défié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Saint d’Israël.
fr.R: Appelez des soldats armés d’arcs pour attaquer Babylone. Installez vos camps tout autour de la ville. Ne laissez personne s’échapper. \q Faites payer Babylone pour ce qu’elle a fait. \q Faites-lui ce qu’elle a fait aux autres. \q Elle a été orgueilleuse et a défié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Saint d’Israël.

sw.L: Waiteni wapiga mishale juu ya Babeli, wote wapindao upinde; pigeni kambi juu yake pande zote; asiwe na mtu wa kuokoka. \q Mlipeni sawasawa na matendo yake; \q mtendeeni sawasawa na yote aliyoyatenda, \q kwa maana amejivuna juu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, juu ya Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Waiteni wapiga upinde waje juu ya Babeli, wote wavutao upinde. Pigeni kambi kumzunguka; asiokoke mtu yeyote. \q Mlipeni kwa yale aliyoyatenda; \q mtendeeni kama alivyotenda, \q kwa maana amemkaidi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kiburi chake, Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Waiteni askari wenye pinde waishambulie Babeli. Wekeni kambi zenu kuuzunguka mji. Msimwache mtu yeyote atoroke. \q Ilipizeni Babeli kwa yale iliyoyatenda. \q Itendeeni kama ilivyowatendea wengine. \q Ilijivuna na kumkaidi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mtakatifu wa Israeli.

vi.L: Hãy triệu tập các cung thủ đến đánh Ba-by-lôn, mọi kẻ giương cung; hãy đóng trại vây quanh nó; đừng để ai thoát khỏi. \q Hãy báo trả nó theo việc nó làm; \q hãy làm cho nó y như mọi điều nó đã làm, \q vì nó đã kiêu ngạo nghịch cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nghịch cùng Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Hãy gọi các cung thủ đến đánh Ba-by-lôn, mọi kẻ giương cung. Hãy đóng trại vây quanh nó; đừng để ai thoát. \q Hãy báo trả nó theo việc nó đã làm; \q hãy làm cho nó y như nó đã làm, \q vì nó đã kiêu căng thách thức {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Hãy gọi những người lính cầm cung đến tấn công Ba-by-lôn. Hãy đóng trại vây quanh thành. Đừng để ai trốn thoát. \q Hãy báo trả Ba-by-lôn về những gì nó đã làm. \q Hãy làm cho nó điều nó đã làm cho người khác. \q Nó đã kiêu ngạo thách thức {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên.

decisions.choice: archers
decisions.reason: The word usually means "many", but here it is taken from a verb meaning "to shoot" (Job 16:13), as the next words, "all who bend the bow", show. Some read "summon many against Babylon".

decisions.choice: she has acted arrogantly: pride that defies God
decisions.reason: The verb means to act with insolence, to set oneself up against God (Exodus 18:11; Deuteronomy 18:22). Babylon's pride is the charge on which it is judged; verses 31-32 call it "Arrogance" by name.

decisions.choice: the Holy One of Israel: Isaiah's title for God
decisions.reason: The title is found often in Isaiah (1:4; 47:4) but in Jeremiah only here and in 51:5. God is holy, wholly other and pure, and he has bound himself to Israel; to defy him is to defy Israel's God.

decisions.choice: repay her ... do to her: as in verse 15
decisions.reason: The demand that Babylon be paid back for what it did is repeated (verse 15; 51:24; Psalm 137:8).

decisions.choice: defied ... in her pride (B); was proud and defied (R); soldiers with bows (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out the arrogance as defiance. Readable names the archers as in verse 14.

decisions.choice: el Santo de Israel
decisions.reason: The title as set in the terms note (2 Kings 19:22).

decisions.choice: "Mtakatifu wa Israeli" at every level
decisions.reason: The title set for the Holy One of Israel in Swahili, as 2 Kings 19:22.

decisions.choice: "le Saint d’Israël" at every level
decisions.reason: The title as the French terms note sets it (2 Kings 19:22; Psalm 78:41).

decisions.choice: Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên
decisions.reason: The title set for these books (2 Kings 19:22; Psalm 78:41), at every level.

source.text: לָכֵ֛ן יִפְּל֥וּ בַחוּרֶ֖יהָ בִּרְחֹבֹתֶ֑יהָ וְכָל־אַנְשֵׁ֨י מִלְחַמְתָּ֥הּ יִדַּ֛מּוּ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Therefore will fall her young men in her squares, and all her men of war will be silenced in the day that, declares Yahweh.

en.L: Therefore her young men will fall in her squares, \q and all her men of war will be silenced in that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: So her young men will fall in her streets, \q and all her soldiers will be silenced on that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: So Babylon's young men will be killed in the city squares. \q All its soldiers will die on that day, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Por eso caerán sus jóvenes en sus plazas, \q y todos sus hombres de guerra serán silenciados en aquel día, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Por eso sus jóvenes caerán en sus calles, \q y todos sus soldados serán silenciados aquel día, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Por eso los jóvenes de Babilonia morirán en las plazas de la ciudad. \q Todos sus soldados morirán ese día, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ses jeunes gens tomberont sur ses places, \q et tous ses hommes de guerre seront réduits au silence en ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi ses jeunes gens tomberont dans ses rues, \q et tous ses soldats seront réduits au silence ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors les jeunes gens de Babylone seront tués sur les places de la ville. \q Tous ses soldats mourront ce jour-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo vijana wake wataanguka katika viwanja vyake, \q na watu wake wote wa vita watanyamazishwa katika siku ile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo vijana wake wataanguka katika mitaa yake, \q na askari wake wote watanyamazishwa siku hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo vijana wa Babeli watauawa katika viwanja vya mji. \q Askari wake wote watakufa wakati huo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Vì vậy các thanh niên của nó sẽ ngã trên các quảng trường, \q và mọi quân lính của nó sẽ bị làm cho câm lặng trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Vì thế các thanh niên của nó sẽ ngã trên đường phố, \q và mọi quân lính của nó sẽ im bặt trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Vì thế các thanh niên của Ba-by-lôn sẽ bị giết tại các quảng trường. \q Mọi quân lính của nó sẽ chết trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

decisions.choice: repeats 49:26
decisions.reason: The verse repeats, almost word for word, what is said of Damascus in 49:26. The same end comes to Babylon.

decisions.choice: will be silenced: will fall silent in death
decisions.reason: The verb means to be silent, and so to be struck dumb or to perish (8:14; 25:37; 48:2).

decisions.choice: her squares: the open places of the city
decisions.reason: The word means the broad open spaces inside the city gates, where people met and markets were held (5:1; 9:20).

decisions.choice: soldiers (B, R); will die (R)
decisions.reason: "Men of war" means soldiers. Readable says plainly what "silenced" means here (meaning decision m2).

source.text: הִנְנִ֤י אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ זָד֔וֹן נְאֻם־אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת כִּ֛י בָּ֥א יוֹמְךָ֖ עֵ֥ת פְּקַדְתִּֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, I [am] against you, Arrogance, declares [the] Lord Yahweh of hosts, for has come your day, [the] time [that] I will punish you.

en.L: Look, I am against you, Arrogance, \q declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts, \q for your day has come, the time that I will punish you.
en.B: I am against you, Arrogant One, \q declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies, \q for your day has arrived, the time for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to punish you.
en.R: Listen, you proud city! I am your enemy, \q says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q Your day has come, the time for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to punish you.

es.L: He aquí, yo estoy contra ti, Soberbia, \q declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, \q porque ha llegado tu día, el tiempo en que te castigaré.
es.B: Estoy contra ti, Soberbia, \q afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, \q porque ha llegado tu día, el tiempo en que te castigaré.
es.R: ¡Escucha, ciudad orgullosa! Yo soy tu enemigo, \q dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q Ha llegado tu día, el tiempo en que te castigaré.

fr.L: Voici, je suis contre toi, Arrogance, \q déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées, \q car ton jour est venu, le temps où je te punirai.
fr.B: Je suis contre toi, l’Orgueilleuse, \q déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées, \q car ton jour est arrivé, le temps où je te punirai.
fr.R: Écoute, ville orgueilleuse ! Je suis ton ennemi, \q dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Ton jour est venu, le moment où je vais te punir.

sw.L: Tazama, mimi ni juu yako, ewe Kiburi, \q asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q kwa maana siku yako imefika, wakati nitakapokuadhibu.
sw.B: Mimi niko dhidi yako, ewe Mwenye Kiburi, \q asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q kwa maana siku yako imefika, wakati wa mimi kukuadhibu.
sw.R: Sikiliza, ewe mji wenye kiburi! Mimi ni adui yako, \q anasema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Siku yako imefika, wakati wa mimi kukuadhibu.

vi.L: Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chống lại ngươi, hỡi Kẻ Kiêu Ngạo, \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, \q vì ngày của ngươi đã đến, là thời kỳ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phạt ngươi.
vi.B: Hỡi Kẻ Kiêu Ngạo, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chống lại ngươi, \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, \q vì ngày của ngươi đã đến, là lúc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trừng phạt ngươi.
vi.R: Hãy nghe đây, hỡi thành kiêu ngạo! Ta là kẻ thù của ngươi, \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. \q Ngày của ngươi đã đến, là lúc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trừng phạt ngươi.

decisions.choice: Arrogance: pride used as a name for Babylon
decisions.reason: The word means pride, insolence (49:16). Here and in verse 32 it stands where a name stands, as God calls Babylon by its chief sin: "Arrogance", or "Proud One". Egypt is named in the same way "Rahab" in Isaiah 30:7.

decisions.choice: I am against you: I am your enemy
decisions.reason: This is a formula of open hostility, God declaring war on a city or people (21:13; 51:25; Nahum 2:14).

decisions.choice: your day, the time that I will punish you
decisions.reason: As in verse 27, the day is the time God has set to call Babylon to account.

decisions.choice: Arrogance (L); Arrogant One (B); you proud city (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the noun as a name. Balanced makes it a title for a person, and Readable says plainly whom God addresses. All three take it as a name for Babylon (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: Soberbia (L, B); ciudad orgullosa (R)
decisions.reason: Babylon is named by its pride, "Arrogance", as a title.

decisions.choice: "Kiburi" (L); "Mwenye Kiburi" (B); "mji wenye kiburi" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the name "Arrogance" given to Babylon, Balanced makes it a title, Readable says who is meant.

decisions.choice: Kẻ Kiêu Ngạo (L, B); thành kiêu ngạo (R)
decisions.reason: Babylon is called by the name "Arrogance"; Vietnamese makes it a person's title, capitalised, at Literal and Balanced, and Readable names the proud city.

source.text: וְכָשַׁ֤ל זָדוֹן֙ וְנָפַ֔ל וְאֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ מֵקִ֑ים וְהִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּעָרָ֔יו וְאָכְלָ֖ה כָּל־סְבִיבֹתָֽיו׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And will stumble Arrogance and fall, and there [is] none for him raising [him] up; and I will kindle fire in his cities, and it will devour all around him.

en.L: And Arrogance will stumble and fall, \q with no one to raise him up; \q and I will kindle a fire in his cities, \q and it will devour all that is around him.
en.B: The Arrogant One will stumble and fall, \q and no one will lift him up. \q I will set fire to his towns, \q and it will consume everything around him.
en.R: The proud city will trip and fall, \q and no one will help it get up. \q I will set its towns on fire, \q and the fire will burn up everything around it.

es.L: Y Soberbia tropezará y caerá, \q y no habrá quien la levante; \q y encenderé fuego en sus ciudades, \q y devorará todo lo que está a su alrededor.
es.B: La Soberbia tropezará y caerá, \q y nadie la levantará. \q Prenderé fuego a sus ciudades, \q y consumirá todo lo que la rodea.
es.R: La ciudad orgullosa tropezará y caerá, \q y nadie la ayudará a levantarse. \q Prenderé fuego a sus ciudades, \q y el fuego quemará todo lo que la rodea.

fr.L: Et Arrogance trébuchera et tombera, \q sans personne pour la relever ; \q et j’allumerai un feu dans ses villes, \q et il dévorera tout ce qui l’entoure.
fr.B: L’Orgueilleuse trébuchera et tombera, \q et personne ne la relèvera. \q Je mettrai le feu à ses villes, \q et il dévorera tout autour d’elle.
fr.R: La ville orgueilleuse trébuchera et tombera, \q et personne ne l’aidera à se relever. \q Je mettrai le feu à ses villes, \q et le feu brûlera tout autour d’elle.

sw.L: Naye Kiburi atajikwaa na kuanguka, \q wala hakuna wa kumwinua; \q nami nitawasha moto katika miji yake, \q nao utakula vyote vinavyomzunguka.
sw.B: Mwenye Kiburi atajikwaa na kuanguka, \q wala hakuna atakayemwinua. \q Nitaiwasha moto miji yake, \q nao utateketeza kila kitu kinachomzunguka.
sw.R: Mji wenye kiburi utajikwaa na kuanguka, \q wala hakuna atakayeusaidia kuinuka. \q Nitaiwasha moto miji yake, \q na moto huo utateketeza kila kitu kinachouzunguka.

vi.L: Kẻ Kiêu Ngạo sẽ vấp và ngã, \q không ai đỡ nó dậy; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm lửa trong các thành của nó, \q và lửa sẽ thiêu nuốt mọi vật chung quanh nó.
vi.B: Kẻ Kiêu Ngạo sẽ vấp và ngã, \q và không ai nâng nó dậy. \q Ta sẽ phóng hỏa các thành của nó, \q và lửa sẽ thiêu rụi mọi vật chung quanh nó.
vi.R: Thành kiêu ngạo sẽ vấp ngã, \q và không ai giúp nó đứng dậy. \q Ta sẽ phóng hỏa các thành của nó, \q và lửa sẽ thiêu rụi mọi vật chung quanh nó.

decisions.choice: him, his: Babylon spoken of by its name "Arrogance"
decisions.reason: The name is a masculine word, so Babylon, usually "she" in this chapter, is here "he". The person meant is still the city and its empire, perhaps with its king.

decisions.choice: fire that devours all around: as in 21:14
decisions.reason: God threatened Jerusalem in the same words (21:14; compare 17:27; 49:27). "No one to raise him up" echoes the lament over Israel in Amos 5:2.

decisions.choice: The proud city ... it
decisions.reason: Readable names the city as in verse 31 and calls it "it".

decisions.choice: "Arrogance ... la relever" (L); "l’Orgueilleuse ... la" (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is masculine ("him"), but French refers to Babylon, a city, with feminine forms, as elsewhere in these chapters.

source.text: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עֲשׁוּקִ֛ים בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל וּבְנֵי־יְהוּדָ֖ה יַחְדָּ֑ו וְכָל־שֹֽׁבֵיהֶם֙ הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ בָ֔ם מֵאֲנ֖וּ שַׁלְּחָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: oppressed [are the] sons of Israel and [the] sons of Judah together, and all their captors have held fast to them; they have refused to let them go.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: \q The {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel are oppressed, and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah with them; \q all who took them captive have held them fast; \q they have refused to let them go.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: \q The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} are oppressed, and the {{gender:people of Judah|sons of Judah}} as well. \q All their captors hold them tight \q and refuse to let them go.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: \q The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} and the {{gender:people of Judah|sons of Judah}} are both being treated cruelly. \q The people who captured them hold on to them \q and will not let them go.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: \q Oprimidos están los hijos de Israel, y los hijos de Judá con ellos; \q todos los que los cautivaron los retienen; \q se niegan a dejarlos ir.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: \q Los israelitas están oprimidos, y también la gente de Judá. \q Todos sus captores los tienen bien sujetos \q y se niegan a dejarlos ir.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: \q Los israelitas y la gente de Judá están siendo maltratados. \q La gente que los capturó no los suelta \q y no los quiere dejar ir.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : \q Les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël sont opprimés, et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda avec eux ; \q tous ceux qui les ont emmenés captifs les retiennent ; \q ils refusent de les laisser partir.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : \q Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} sont opprimés, et les {{gender:gens de Juda|fils de Juda}} aussi. \q Tous ceux qui les ont capturés les tiennent fermement \q et refusent de les laisser partir.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : \q Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} et les {{gender:gens de Juda|fils de Juda}} sont tous les deux maltraités. \q Ceux qui les ont capturés les retiennent \q et ne veulent pas les laisser partir.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: \q Wana wa Israeli wameonewa, na wana wa Yuda pamoja nao; \q wote waliowachukua mateka wamewashika sana; \q wamekataa kuwaachilia.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: \q Waisraeli wanaonewa, na watu wa Yuda vilevile. \q Wote waliowateka wanawashika kwa nguvu \q na kukataa kuwaachilia.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: \q Waisraeli na watu wa Yuda wote wanatendewa ukatili. \q Watu waliowateka wanawashikilia \q wala hawataki kuwaachilia.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: \q Con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên bị áp bức, con cái Giu-đa cũng vậy; \q mọi kẻ bắt chúng làm phu tù đều giữ chặt chúng; \q chúng không chịu thả chúng đi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: \q Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên bị áp bức, dân Giu-đa cũng vậy. \q Mọi kẻ bắt chúng đều giữ chặt chúng \q và không chịu thả chúng ra.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: \q Cả dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lẫn dân Giu-đa đều bị đối xử tàn tệ. \q Những kẻ bắt họ giữ chặt lấy họ \q và không chịu thả họ đi.

decisions.choice: they refused to let them go: like Pharaoh in Egypt
decisions.reason: The words recall Pharaoh, who refused to let Israel go (Exodus 4:23; 7:14; 9:2). Babylon plays the part of Egypt, and the return from exile is a new exodus (16:14-15; 23:7-8).

decisions.choice: Israel and Judah together: both peoples in exile, both to be freed
decisions.reason: As in verse 4, the northern and southern peoples are named together. Both were taken captive, by Assyria and by Babylon, and both are under God's care.

decisions.choice: children of Israel (L); Israelites (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for "sons of Israel", with the traditional form as the alternative; "sons of Judah" follows it. The messenger formula is the book's settled wording.

source.text: גֹּאֲלָ֣ם׀חָזָ֗ק יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ שְׁמ֔וֹ רִ֥יב יָרִ֖יב אֶת־רִיבָ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן֙ הִרְגִּ֣יעַ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִרְגִּ֖יז לְיֹשְׁבֵ֥י בָבֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Their Redeemer [is] strong; Yahweh of hosts [is] his name; surely he will plead their case, so as to give rest to the earth and to give unrest to [the] inhabitants of Babylon.

en.L: Their Redeemer is strong; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. \q He will surely plead their case, \q so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} may give rest to the earth \q and give unrest to the inhabitants of Babylon.
en.B: Their Redeemer is strong; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. \q He will take up their case and win it, \q so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} may bring rest to the earth \q and turmoil to those who live in Babylon.
en.R: But the one who rescues them is strong. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. \q He will stand up for them and win their case. \q He will give rest to the earth, \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will bring trouble on the people of Babylon.

es.L: Su Redentor es fuerte; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. \q Ciertamente defenderá la causa de ellos, \q para dar reposo a la tierra \q y turbar a los habitantes de Babilonia.
es.B: Su Redentor es fuerte; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. \q Él defenderá su causa y la ganará, \q para traer reposo a la tierra \q y agitación a los que viven en Babilonia.
es.R: Pero el que los rescata es fuerte. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. \q Él los defenderá y ganará su causa. \q Él dará reposo a la tierra, \q pero traerá problemas a la gente de Babilonia.

fr.L: Leur Rédempteur est fort ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. \q Il défendra sûrement leur cause, \q afin de donner le repos à la terre \q et l’agitation aux habitants de Babylone.
fr.B: Leur Libérateur est fort ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. \q Il prendra leur cause en main et la gagnera, \q pour apporter le repos à la terre \q et le trouble à ceux qui habitent Babylone.
fr.R: Mais celui qui les délivre est fort. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. \q Il prendra leur défense et gagnera leur procès. \q Il donnera le repos à la terre, \q mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera venir le trouble sur les habitants de Babylone.

sw.L: Mkombozi wao ni hodari; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. \q Hakika atawatetea katika shauri lao, \q ili aipe nchi raha \q na kuwapa wakaaji wa Babeli fadhaa.
sw.B: Mkombozi wao ni mwenye nguvu; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. \q Atalichukua shauri lao na kulishinda, \q ili ailetee dunia raha \q na kuwaletea wanaoishi Babeli fadhaa.
sw.R: Lakini yeye anayewaokoa ni mwenye nguvu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. \q Atawatetea na kushinda shauri lao. \q Ataipa dunia raha, \q lakini ataleta taabu juu ya watu wa Babeli.

vi.L: Đấng Cứu Chuộc của chúng thật mạnh mẽ; danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân. \q Ngài chắc chắn sẽ binh vực duyên cớ của chúng, \q để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban sự yên nghỉ cho đất \q và làm cho dân cư Ba-by-lôn phải xao động.
vi.B: Đấng Cứu Chuộc của chúng thật mạnh mẽ; danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân. \q Ngài sẽ đứng ra binh vực và thắng kiện cho chúng, \q để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đem lại sự yên nghỉ cho đất \q và sự náo loạn cho những kẻ sống tại Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Nhưng Đấng giải cứu họ thật mạnh mẽ. Danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân. \q Ngài sẽ đứng ra bênh vực họ và thắng kiện. \q Ngài sẽ ban sự yên nghỉ cho đất, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đem rối loạn đến cho dân Ba-by-lôn.

decisions.choice: their Redeemer: the next of kin who buys back and defends
decisions.reason: A redeemer was the relative who bought back a family member sold into slavery and stood up for him (Leviticus 25:47-49; Ruth 4). God takes that part for his captive people: their captors will not let them go (verse 33), but their Redeemer is stronger. The words echo Isaiah 47:4, "Our Redeemer, the LORD of hosts is his name".

decisions.choice: he will surely plead their case: he will act as their defender in court
decisions.reason: The doubled verb makes it certain. God is pictured as the advocate who takes up the case of the helpless and wins it (51:36; Micah 7:9). Proverbs 23:10-11 uses almost the same words of the orphan's strong Redeemer.

decisions.choice: rest ... unrest: a play on two words that sound alike
decisions.reason: The two verbs sound alike and mean opposite things: to give rest and to make tremble. The earth, crushed by Babylon, will have rest; Babylon will have none.

decisions.choice: the one who rescues them
decisions.reason: Readable explains "Redeemer", as the settled wording allows, and makes the court picture plain.

decisions.choice: Su Redentor (L, B); el que los rescata (R)
decisions.reason: *Goʾel* of God, as set in the terms note: "Redentor" as a title at Literal and Balanced, "rescatar" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "Mkombozi wao" (L, B); "yeye anayewaokoa" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for God as *goʾel* in Swahili, as Proverbs 23:11; the play on "rest" and "unrest" is kept with "raha" and "fadhaa".

decisions.choice: "Rédempteur" (L), "Libérateur" (B), "celui qui les délivre" (R)
decisions.reason: *Goʾel* of God as the French terms note sets it.

decisions.choice: Đấng Cứu Chuộc (L, B); Đấng giải cứu (R)
decisions.reason: *Go'el* of God is the title "Đấng Cứu Chuộc", capitalised, as the terms note sets; Readable may say "Đấng giải cứu", as Psalm 19:15 R does.

source.text: חֶ֥רֶב עַל־כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בָבֶ֔ל וְאֶל־שָׂרֶ֖יהָ וְאֶל־חֲכָמֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] sword against [the] Chaldeans, declares Yahweh, and against [the] inhabitants of Babylon, and against her princes, and against her wise [men].

en.L: A sword against the Chaldeans, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and against the inhabitants of Babylon, \q and against her princes and against her wise men!
en.B: A sword against the Chaldeans, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q against the people of Babylon, \q against her officials and her wise men!
en.R: A sword will strike the Babylonians, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q It will strike the people who live in Babylon, \q its leaders and its wise men.

es.L: ¡Espada contra los caldeos, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q y contra los habitantes de Babilonia, \q y contra sus príncipes y contra sus sabios!
es.B: ¡Espada contra los caldeos, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q contra la gente de Babilonia, \q contra sus jefes y sus sabios!
es.R: La espada herirá a los babilonios, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Herirá a la gente que vive en Babilonia, \q a sus dirigentes y a sus sabios.

fr.L: L’épée contre les Chaldéens, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et contre les habitants de Babylone, \q et contre ses princes, et contre ses sages !
fr.B: L’épée contre les Chaldéens, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q contre les habitants de Babylone, \q contre ses chefs et ses sages !
fr.R: L’épée frappera les Babyloniens, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Elle frappera les habitants de Babylone, \q ses chefs et ses sages.

sw.L: Upanga juu ya Wakaldayo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na juu ya wakaaji wa Babeli, \q na juu ya wakuu wake na juu ya wenye hekima wake!
sw.B: Upanga dhidi ya Wakaldayo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q dhidi ya watu wa Babeli, \q dhidi ya maafisa wake na wenye hekima wake!
sw.R: Upanga utawapiga Wababeli, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Utawapiga watu wanaoishi Babeli, \q viongozi wake na wenye hekima wake.

vi.L: Gươm nghịch cùng người Canh-đê, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q nghịch cùng dân cư Ba-by-lôn, \q nghịch cùng các quan trưởng và các người khôn ngoan của nó!
vi.B: Gươm nghịch cùng người Canh-đê, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q nghịch cùng dân Ba-by-lôn, \q nghịch cùng các quan chức và các người khôn ngoan của nó!
vi.R: Gươm sẽ đánh người Ba-by-lôn, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. \q Gươm sẽ đánh những người sống tại Ba-by-lôn, \q các nhà lãnh đạo và các người khôn ngoan của nó.

decisions.choice: A sword against ...: a chant of judgment
decisions.reason: The word "sword" begins five lines in verses 35-37, each naming a part of Babylon's strength, and a sixth line (verse 38) plays on it. The lines have no verb: they are a war chant, as in Ezekiel 21:14-15.

decisions.choice: her wise men: the scholars and advisers of the court
